newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Outlook bright for Portugal building sector - INE.
newsitem.headline: Outlook bright for Portugal building sector - INE.

text.p: The outlook for Portuguese construction and public works in the second quarter of 1997 is positive, with order books remaining at the same levels seen in the first three months, the National Statistics Institute said in its latest report.
"In April, the confidence indicator was marginally more positive than in the preceding month, maintaining the upward trend of the last few months," it said.
It said that in the first quarter, capacity utilisation stood at 75 percent.
In terms of prices, the trend was for lower prices in the public works sector but in other areas, notably non-residential building, the trend was upwards, it said.
The outlook for manufacturing industry over the current quarter was also positive, the Institute said.
Expectations for an increase in prices remained "modest", the Institute said, but above the same period last year.
"The confidence indicator was higher than at the same period last year, extending the uptrend seen over the past 12 months," it said.
The wholesale and retail activity index did not rise in April, interrupting an uptrend stretching back several months, but it remained above levels of a year ago, it said.
